newsitems.title: 25,000 Wishlists and a New Stage of Development!
newsitems.author: kikosan053
newsitems.contents: We are here with some great news: the cinematic trailer received a massive response. In just three weeks, SKOS: 13.86 has gathered 25,000 wishlists, and the number keeps growing. Thank you so much for this vote of confidence.The Based Paw Crew understands that you want to see gameplay. Right now, we are fully focused on creating the prototype and will be self-funding the project over the coming months. Why? It's simple: it allows us to retain complete creative freedom. So please, bear with us and be patient.And yes, one more thing. We want to turn this game into an unforgettable experience, which is impossible without a distinct visual style. To achieve this, we have launched a Discord server where we will shape the look of SKOS: 13.86 together with you. We started by posting the trailer there, and much more is on the way.We won't hide our development behind closed doors. We are always active on the server: any question, idea, or critique will reach us directly.👉 Welcome to Discord 👈
